data.one_liner: Add a drawer menu feature with perspective animation to your Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Provides a hidden drawer menu widget with perspective animation effects. Supports both a pre-defined layout and fully customized menus using controller methods.
use_when: You want a modern drawer menu with perspective animations.
You need a simple pre-built multi-screen drawer setup or a fully customizable menu structure.
avoid_when: You require a standard Material Design end/start drawer without custom perspective transformations.
You are building a desktop-first app that relies heavily on a permanent side navigation rail.
strengths: Provides both a ready-to-use default menu and a fully customizable menu option.
Includes built-in controller methods for toggling, opening, closing, and listening to states.
weaknesses: Limited to hidden drawer menu paradigms.
Customizing deeply beyond the provided settings may require falling back to the lower-level animation builder.
